before.story: El Salvador Deploys Forces to Rescue Kidnapped Soldiers in Haiti
before.summary: After armed gangs ambushed a UN-backed security convoy near Port-au-Prince and captured four Salvadoran aviation technicians who fled their burning vehicle, Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele deployed special forces to Haiti and subsequently escalated deployments to over 2,000 soldiers as national elections were postponed. Bukele publicly dismissed reports that human remains discovered during search sweeps belonged to the abducted service members.

after.story: El Salvador Troops Strike Haitian Gang Compound
after.summary: Following the kidnapping of four Salvadoran aviation technicians by armed gangs in Port-au-Prince, President Nayib Bukele deployed over 2,000 special forces to Haiti, culminating in a rocket strike that destroyed a 400 Mawozo gang compound and earned praise from Haitian Prime Minister Alix Didier Fils-Aime.

note: Salvadoran troops destroyed a 400 Mawozo gang headquarters in Port-au-Prince using rocket fire.

before.story: Australian Teen Missing in Bush Rescued Alive
before.summary: Emergency services in Victoria, Australia, successfully rescued 17-year-old William alive after he spent six days lost in dense bushland near Walhalla in Gippsland. The teenager was reunited with his family following an intensive search operation that utilized ground crews and trail camera evidence to track his movements.

after.story: Australian Teen Missing in Bush Rescued Alive
after.summary: Emergency services in Victoria, Australia, successfully rescued 17-year-old William—identified in police reports as an autistic teenager—alive after he spent six days lost in dense bushland near Walhalla in Gippsland. The teenager was reunited with his family following an intensive search operation utilizing ground crews and trail camera evidence.

note: South China Morning Post notes the 17-year-old boy rescued after six days has autism.

before.story: Taiwan Appoints Acer Founder Stan Shih as APEC Envoy
before.summary: Taiwan has appointed Acer co-founder Stan Shih to represent President Lai Ching-te at the upcoming APEC leaders' summit in Shenzhen. The appointment comes alongside a formal request for Beijing to provide written guarantees ensuring the Taiwanese delegation is treated with dignity and equal footing during the proceedings.

after.story: Taiwan Appoints Acer Founder Stan Shih as APEC Envoy
after.summary: Taiwan has appointed Acer co-founder Stan Shih to represent President Lai Ching-te at the upcoming APEC leaders' summit in Shenzhen, alongside a formal request for Beijing to provide written guarantees ensuring the Taiwanese delegation is treated with dignity and equal footing during proceedings.

note: South Korea's President Lee to visit Philippines and attend APEC summit in China.
